# Remember our first recitation?

![](images/SPOTLIGHT%20-%20What%20is%20Linguistics%20Research_3.png)



* Discussion of different words for things
  * Pop\, soda\, coke
  * Lightning bug\, firefly
  * Roly poly\, potato bug\, pill bug
* And of different pronunciations\!
  * Wash v\. wa\(r\)sh
  * Says “pin” and “pen” differently v\. the same
  * Caramel \(care\-uh\-mel v\. car\-mul\)

# Practical & specific?

![](images/SPOTLIGHT%20-%20What%20is%20Linguistics%20Research_9.png)



* __Practical__
  * You can just ask people what they say\!
  * Most people will have a word for this
  * Often differences are based on where people are from
* __Specific__
  * “Where”
  * “Carbonated beverage”

---


# Why do we care?

The way we speak says things about who we are \(in this case: where we are from\)

Showing that different ways of speech ≠ bad

If we understand other ways of speaking\, we can communicate better

It’s interesting\!

![](images/SPOTLIGHT%20-%20What%20is%20Linguistics%20Research_10.png)

# In Conclusion



* Linguistics research spans all different types of questions\!
* Asking good research questions means
  * Connections to previous research
  * Practical & specific topics
* Looking at regions where people speak differently is one of  __many __ ways to answer a question about language
* Being a good researcher = being curious
